scope: iOS simulator compatibility and functional smoke verification; isolated app; no physical device execution
checks: real source rendering through production readers
same analytic curl shader on Metal
texture resolution matches native DPR with per-page pixel target

fixes.slider_semantics: Key slider state by enabled/disabled status to prevent detached semantic-parent references. Failed synthetic enabled-semantics source-switch regression now passes.
fixes.capture_typography: Provide Material context for the captured EPUB renderer; remove inherited debug fallback text decoration.
fixes.capture_accessibility: Exclude the background capture subtree from accessibility; keep its wrapper stable and release unused content on format switch.
fixes.texture_resolution: Keep requested DPR separate from the effective per-page DPR so single-page pixel capping does not permanently lower double-page resolution.

privacy.reports: anonymous format, dimensions and boolean check results only

limitations: Debug simulators running on the Mac GPU; no performance, thermal, real input-to-display latency or memory conclusions for iPhones/iPads.
Gesture sequences are injected into Flutter by integration_test; native UIKit touch delivery, system touch interruption and full VoiceOver interaction are not verified.
Portrait phone and tablet viewports; no landscape rotation or resume-from-background coverage in this run.
EPUB uses one selected chapter; fixed-layout sources use the opening page windows. No full-book or chapter-transition coverage.
Per-page target is 1,000,000 pixels, with dimensions rounded upward; content is not always full panel resolution.
Earlier prototype EPUB snapshots inherited debug fallback typography; their line breaks and layout timings are not directly comparable to the corrected capture.
No Apple Books side-by-side quality comparison; production reader integration remains pending.

manual_previews.source_inputs: isolated app Documents; no production library writes

visual_review: Native-resolution phone/tablet previews and selected corner captures reviewed; normal typography, curl shading and aspect-ratio containment visible.
